BiblicalUsage: tᵉqôph stands behind the English phrase power, might. In Daniel 2:37, power, and strength, and glory, and it appears again in Daniel 4:30.
TheologicalSignificance: Nebuchadnezzar boasting of his own power reminds me that every throne I trust in is borrowed, not mine.
